authorization: Owner, in the project chat on November 23, 2026: "get started on the ml run". Given after the assistant presented this 36-run plan and its staged stop rules.
metric: Round-mean validation log loss; lower is better. Recomputed from saved predictions.

rules.status: Fixed at approval. The thresholds are the assistant's proposal; the owner started the run without changing them.
rules.metric: Round-mean validation log loss at the selected epoch (lowest all-window validation log loss of 20) and at epoch 20, each for all windows and for windows with a living attacker.
rules.pairs: Within validation map, architecture and seed: structure against the base-arm run that reproduced the saved no_spatial control, placebo against that run, and structure against placebo. Twelve neural pairs each.
rules.structure_helps: Only if structure has the lower selected-epoch log loss than both the control and the placebo in at least 9 of 12 pairs, in both strata.
rules.order_matters: Only if structure helps as defined, lowers the temporal CNN's log loss in at least 5 of its 6 pairs, and the CNN's mean gain exceeds the pooled control's on both maps.
rules.baselines: Report both logistic baselines for control, placebo and structure in each map direction. They do not depend on the neural seed; identical values across a direction's runs are checked as an integrity test.
rules.reporting: Every run is reported, including weaker ones. No arm, seed or map is dropped. A null result is recorded as no demonstrated benefit.

limitations: One series, two maps, 44 rounds, 555 overlapping windows, no independent test set.
The channels were designed from seven windows in these same rounds by a reviewer who had seen the outcomes.
Both maps have been reused for feature development and model selection; results are exploratory.
The entry channels follow two named abilities cast by one player per team in this series.
Seeds vary initialization only. They add no independent matches.
A venv integrity check is not a host malware scan or an OS sandbox.
